def count_inversions(arr):
    if len(arr) <= 1:
        return 0
    else:
        mid = len(arr) // 2
        left = count_inversions(arr[:mid])
        right = count_inversions(arr[mid:])
        merged = count_merging(arr[:mid], arr[mid:])
        return left + right + merged

def count_merging(left, right):
    inversions = 0
    i = j = k = 0
    temp = [0] * (len(left) + len(right))
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] <= right[j]:
            temp[k] = left[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            temp[k] = right[j]
            inversions += len(left) - i
            j += 1
        k += 1
    while i < len(left):
        temp[k] = left[i]
        i += 1
        k += 1
    while j < len(right):
        temp[k] = right[j]
        j += 1
        k += 1
    return inversions
